verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Fellow publishes a live llms.txt at developers.fellow.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled "Fellow Documentation"), describing its API for meeting notes and transcripts, so an agent can be pointed directly at it. That satisfies the story as written. Missing for 10: no evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt or other expanded agent-oriented doc bundle, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and no hands-on or independent confirmation of an agent consuming the docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.fellow.ai/llms.txt # Fellow Documentation
